messages:
paul_support: Customer reports SSE chat stream cuts out mid-response when they switch from corporate VPN (split-tunnel) to cellular. They say last ~200 chars missing, but tokens appear billed. Repro steps attached.

micaela_cs: +1 on repro. Customer says it happens reliably when VPN disconnects during an in-flight stream. They captured client logs and a small HAR.

devon_eng: Can you paste the client logs and the request headers? Need to know if the client attempted reconnect (Last-Event-ID) or if proxy tore the TCP. Also whether we saw a 499/EOF on the LB.

paul_support: From customer logs (redacted):
```
SSE: GET /v1/stream?session=abc123
Host: api.redwood.ai
Connection: keep-alive
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Client-IP: 10.10.20.5 -> 34.201.12.10 (after switch)

Client log:
2026-03-15T18:02:33Z EVENT: chunk #42 received
2026-03-15T18:02:35Z NETWORK: VPN disconnected, new IP assigned
2026-03-15T18:02:35Z SSE: socket closed (EOF)
2026-03-15T18:02:35Z APP: attempted reconnect but server returned 200 with new stream (no resume)
```

paul_support: Customer attached server correlation id: r-0a1b2c3d. Tim, any LB logs for that id?

tim_oncall: Pulling logs... I see on the edge proxy we have a 502 -> upstream connection reset at same timestamp, then a tcp FIN from customer IP. Proxy has 60s idle timeout on upgraded connections for that route; but this is immediate reset after IP change. Edge doesn't attempt resume. devon, sounds like we need a graceful resume feature or explicit guidance.

devon_eng: Confirming: current server behaviour is no resume for SSE — we treat new connection as new session. If client changes IP mid-stream, there's no automatic splice/replay. We do support client-sent resume via Last-Event-ID for some streaming types but not for chat token-level resume.

micaela_cs: Customer asking about billing — they got charged for tokens corresponding to partial message. Is that expected? They want refund for truncated output.

paul_support: Billing note: standard hosted API charges per token ingested/generated; if generation aborted mid-stream we still bill generated tokens. Escalating to billing for goodwill refund.

devon_eng: Two action items: 1) short-term: recommend client-side mitigations to customer (keepalive pings every 15s, implement Last-Event-ID / idempotent message ids, and on network change retry with resume attempt). Example curl for testing: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-small&session=abc123"
# simulate: flip network, then reconnect with Last-Event-ID:42 header
```

2) long-term: we should consider marking streaming responses with server-side resume tokens (checkpoint ids) so clients can request resume from checkpoint X. Also look at proxy behaviour on ip-change to surface 409/410 code rather than ambiguous reset.

tim_oncall: Filed infra ticket INF-2026-214 for edge timeout & connection metadata. I'll attach LB trace for r-0a1b2c3d.

deploy-bot: deploy: edge-proxy-canary v2026.03.14-conn-meta leaked -> rolled to canary in us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T04:22Z :rocket:

micaela_cs: Shared repro steps back to customer so they can test keepalive + resume. Also asked billing to review refund for r-0a1b2c3d.

devon_eng: Quick note: if customer can't change client quickly, suggest using Dedicated/private option where they can control proxy timeouts or run on-prem (reduces NAT/IP rewrite on split-tunnel).

paul_support: Thanks all. Will follow up after infra ticket and billing decision. :thumbsup:
